title: New Orleans nightclubs stayed open around the clock
summary: He says New Orleans clubs never locked their doors and still stay open all night, such as the Brown Derby.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Ohhhh. Way back there. Uhh, when you were in New Orleans, you talked about Chicago being an all-night town, with the Club DeLisa, and New York having after-hours, and here...how about New Orleans? Was New Orleans an around-the-clock...?
New Orleans' clock...never had no locks on the doors in New Orleans in the nightclubs. They stayed open all night long.
All day and all night long. Eve'body had a ball.
You could get up...go get your head bad (?) any time you felt like it. Still that way.
Had a joint they called the Brown Derby...
It was just a bar...located on LaSalle...
